usage: The word '今日' is a noun and means 'today'.
'今日' is used to refer to the current day.
It can be placed at the beginning or middle of a sentence, depending on sentence structure.
You can use '今日' to specify when an action happens, like '今日食飯' means 'eat today'.
'今日' can stand alone or be part of time phrases combined with other words.
